deadline.intake: Winter semester (application period 15.05-15.07; year not stated on page, shown by Informatics B.Sc. page)

tuition.note: Per semester for new non-EU bachelor students: usually 2,000 or 3,000 depending on program; rises to 2,300/3,400 from WS 2027/28

requirement.text: Applicants with an Uzbek school certificate apply as international applicants; proof of German (or English where required) is needed before the application period ends, and many programs have an aptitude assessment. Check certificate recognition and uni-assist/Studienkolleg requirements on the application portal.
